enzo.name: Enzo Moretti
enzo.bio: Lead play-by-play. Grew up above his father's tyre shop near Parma and learned to drive delivering tyres too fast. Raced the Italian junior formulas in his teens; his best result was a soaking-wet second place, which he still describes lap by lap. A broken wrist at 22 ended the career, and he has spent the 25 years since in the commentary box. Loves bravery, late braking and night racing.
enzo.voice_notes: Italian man from Parma, early 50s, warm bright baritone. Speaks fluent English with an unmistakable Italian accent (open vowels, tapped r, Italian rhythm and melody), never British or American; the accent comes from the voice, not the spelling. Very expressive: laughs, chuckles, sighs, sarcasm and mock outrage, quick and energetic, rising to a full shout on big moments. Openly biased towards Saetta and pretends not to be. Italian words (allora, andiamo, bellissimo, mamma mia) are sparing and said naturally.

alastair.name: Alastair Finch
alastair.bio: Colour commentator. Eleven years on the pit wall as a race engineer for privateer endurance teams, where he counted fuel loads and was ignored by drivers. Now an amateur historian writing a very long history of forgotten circuits, and a restorer of old clocks (forty-one at last count) in a cottage full of ticking. Dry, withering and eloquent, theatrically appalled by clumsy driving, secretly devoted to the sport and to Enzo.
alastair.voice_notes: British man, early 60s, crisp received-pronunciation English, precise and unhurried, a long dry delivery with the occasional theatrical sigh. Grumpy rather than cruel; the warmth shows on wins and in the exchanges. Rarely raises his voice, so when he does it lands.

kavya.name: Kavya Iyer
kavya.bio: Paddock reporter. Grew up in Coimbatore, India's racing town, above her mother's motorcycle workshop, and won a national karting title at fifteen. Studied mechanical engineering in Chennai, then spent six years as a tyre engineer for junior teams in Europe, where she learned that drivers lie about tyres and engineers lie about everything else. Now she walks the paddock with a notebook of every driver's habits and superstitions. Quick, warm and teasing: the only person on the broadcast who can make Alastair laugh and Enzo stop talking.
kavya.voice_notes: Indian woman, early 30s, speaks fluent English with a clear, natural Indian accent (Indian English, South Indian lilt), never British RP and never American. Bright, quick and confident broadcast delivery with a smile in the voice; teasing and warm about the drivers, crisp rather than breathy.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [warmly] Free Drive tonight. No grid, no rivals, no Alastair complaining about the start. [chuckles] Well, maybe a little.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Good evening! The whole circuit belongs to you tonight. No Varrone, no Valois, nobody in the mirrors. Go and find the limit, my friend.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Free Drive. No points, no podium, and mercifully no excuses. Do learn the braking markers.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] An empty circuit. The ideal place to make mistakes nobody will remember. Except me.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Buonasera and welcome! Six teams, twelve cars, and not one of them came here to lose. Especially not my Saetta. [clears throat] I mean, the Saetta team. I am completely neutral.
lines.retired: names six teams and twelve cars; the grid is now eight teams and sixteen cars (a race runs eight)

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Good evening, everybody! Race night! The engines are warm, Remy Valois is smiling like he already won, and already I can smell the brakes.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Welcome to the broadcast! Allora, the grid is set: Saetta, Corvid, Kalt, Mojave, Aurum and Sarab. Six teams, one trophy, and tonight somebody becomes a hero.
lines.retired: lists six teams (no Liberty, no Toro)

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Good evening. A full field, a short fuse, and a great deal of expensive carbon at risk.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Welcome. I am told this will be a clean race. I have heard that before. Frequently.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Good evening. Twelve drivers, and at least three of them believe brakes are optional.
lines.retired: twelve drivers; the grid is now sixteen

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Welcome to the Endurance! Hours, not minutes. [chuckles] Kai Whitlow is very happy tonight. For him, this is a short race.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Endurance tonight, my friends. Fast is good, but the car must finish. [sighs] Somebody please explain this to Cole Maddox.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Endurance. My natural habitat. Fuel, tyres, pit windows and the slow, exquisite agony of strategy.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Good evening. Tonight we discover who can be quick for a very long time. Rarely the same person.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Look at that sky, orange over the barriers. Bellissimo. [laughs softly] Even the Mojave cars match the sunset tonight.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: The sun goes down, the lights come on. [warmly] For me, the perfect hour to race. [chuckles] For Alastair, the perfect hour to complain.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Dusk. The light is gorgeous and utterly useless. Braking markers vanish straight into the glare.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Low sun, long shadows. Every apex looks a yard further away than it really is.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Blue hour turning into night, the city lights are on, and the cars look like comets. [whispers] Look at the Aurum gold under the lights. Magnifico.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Night racing! Headlights, sparks, and the noise bouncing off every wall! [laughs] Twelve engines and one very happy Italian.
lines.retired: twelve engines; the grid is now sixteen cars (a race runs eight)

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Night. Depth perception leaves the building, and the barriers take full advantage.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Blue hour. A painter would call it sublime. An engineer calls it reduced visibility.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Rain tonight! Mamma mia! Aiko Tanabe and Freya Lindqvist are smiling. [chuckles] Everybody else is praying.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Wet track, spray everywhere. Gentle hands tonight, or the car will bite. [chuckles] Ask Cole Maddox. He still has the teeth marks.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Rain. Grip is now merely a rumour. Whoever is smoothest will look like a genius.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [sighs] It is raining. Somewhere a set of slick tyres is weeping. So am I.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Welcome to the Corniche Marina Circuit! Street racing along the seafront, yachts in the harbour, concrete walls on every side. This is Sarab's home, and the crowd will be loud for Zayn Kareem. [dramatically] But touch a barrier here, and your race is finished.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Narrow, bumpy, and lined with walls that have ended more promising evenings than I care to count. The marina section is the trick: brake by the water, not by your nerve. And do ignore the yachts. They are not looking at you.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Tonight we are in the Western Ghats of India, for the Sahyadri Ghat Circuit. Hairpins cut into the mountain, mist in the valleys, and a long drop beside the road. [sighs] Mamma mia. This place demands respect, even from Matteo Varrone.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A proper mountain road, built for lorries and monsoons rather than racing cars. The hairpins arrive in clusters, the camber changes its mind halfway round, and the guardrail is the only friend you will have up there. Splendid.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: I am Enzo Moretti! Twenty-five years in this booth, and before that, a skinny kid from Parma in the Italian junior formulas, [laughs] braking much later than was sensible.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Much later. I have seen the footage. Alastair Finch, by the way: former race engineer, and the current conscience of this commentary box.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Beside me, Alastair Finch. Eleven years on the pit wall for endurance teams, and still he counts fuel in his sleep. [chuckles] I have heard him. Litres, litres, litres.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] And beside me, Enzo Moretti, who finished second in a rainstorm twenty-eight years ago and has described every lap of it to me personally.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Every lap was worth describing! And lap fourteen, I will describe again later.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: When I am not here, I am writing a history of forgotten racing circuits. Volume one runs to eight hundred pages.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Eight hundred pages, and he says I talk too much! Allora, he also restores old clocks. [sarcastic] A very patient man. With clocks.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Clocks do not lunge up the inside at the hairpin, Enzo.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Cars rolling to the grid! Twelve drivers, six teams, zero friends.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Formation lap, warming the tyres. [chuckles] Cole Maddox weaves like he is already racing.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Everybody finding their slot. [whispers] You can feel the tension from here.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The formation lap. Twelve drivers pretending to be calm.
lines.retired: twelve drivers; the grid is now sixteen

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Weaving to warm the tyres. Also, I suspect, to settle the stomach.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Grid slots found. Now the only question is who flinches first.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [whispers] The lights are coming on...

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: First light... second... [excited] here we go, here we go!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [whispers] Lights on. Everybody still. Nobody breathe...

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Red lights. The longest seconds in motorsport.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] Lights on. Clutches trembling. Nerves rather more so.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Hold it... hold it... hold it...

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Lights out! Andiamo!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] And they're gone! The race is on!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Go, go, go! Twelve cars charging for turn one!
lines.retired: twelve cars; the grid is now sixteen cars (a race runs eight)

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: And they are released. Mind the first corner, everyone.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Away they go. Turn one awaits its victims.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Lights out. Now let's see who has been practising.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] What a launch! Clean off the line and gaining places!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Perfect reaction! Remy Valois himself could not start better!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Great start! Into turn one with all the momentum!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Like a rocket off the grid! That is how you begin!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A textbook getaway. The clutch work of a surgeon.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Superb reaction time. Somebody was actually concentrating.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Places gained before the first braking zone. Very tidy indeed.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Now that is a start worth watching twice.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Oh no, bogged down! Cars streaming past on both sides!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [frustrated sigh] Slow away. Far too much wheelspin there.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sarcastic] A relaxed start. Very relaxed. Like a Sunday drive to the beach.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Mamma mia, the start is gone! [determined] Now we fight back!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [sighs] That getaway was more of a gentle departure.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Wheelspin, then hesitation. A start to forget.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Swamped. The field went past like commuters past a busker.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Well. That is several places to win back, then.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Through! Up the inside, beautiful move!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Late on the brakes, and the place is taken! Very Varrone!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Around the outside! Mamma mia, what courage!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [chuckles] Another one picked off. Layla Qasimi would approve of that.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Clean pass. No contact, no drama. [sarcastic] Alastair has nothing to complain about.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Neatly done. Not a coat of paint exchanged.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Committed, decisive, and frankly rather elegant.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Dispatched. The victim never saw it coming.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] That driver will be reviewing the mirrors tonight.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: One place gained. Do keep going.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Oh, passed! The door was left wide open there!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sighs] Lost a place. Too polite into that corner. Too polite!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [urgently] They come through on the inside! Respond now, respond now!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [outraged] Overtaken! No, no, no, this is not acceptable! Fight back!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sighs] A place gone. Head down, there is still time.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [sighs] Mugged at the apex. Tragic, and entirely avoidable.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The door was open, and someone walked straight through it.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A position surrendered rather too politely, I thought.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Overtaken. One hopes this is a temporary arrangement.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A lesson in defending, delivered by the other driver.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Into the lead! P1! Bellissimo!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Front of the field! Nobody ahead now, only clear air!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] The lead is taken! [laughs] Now, can they keep it?

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Leading the race! The champion's view, nothing but empty road!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: In the lead. Now comes the difficult part.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: P1. Clear air, and nobody to blame but oneself.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The lead, taken with genuine authority.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] Leading. I may have to revise my predictions.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [outraged] No! No! The lead is gone!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [frustrated sigh] Passed for first place! Mamma mia, so close.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [urgently] Lost P1! Stay in the slipstream, it is not finished!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sighs] Second now. But the fight is still on, my friends!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: And the lead slips away. Momentarily, one hopes.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Leadership is a lease, not a freehold.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: P1 surrendered. That will sting for a while.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Demoted. Now we learn something about their character.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Defending well! Covering the inside line, very clever!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Holding them off! Mirrors, mirrors, mirrors!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Under pressure, but not giving an inch! [laughs] Theo Ashcombe would be proud.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [mischievously] They want the place, but the door is shut. Locked. Bolted.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Firm defending. Within the rules, just about.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The inside is covered. Clever positioning.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: One move only, mind. We are not barbarians.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Calm under pressure. I am almost impressed.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Side by side! Nobody is lifting!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Wheel to wheel into the corner! [dramatically] Who blinks first?

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Door to door! This is racing, my friends!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Together through the turn! The stewards are reaching for their pens!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Side by side. One of them will have to be sensible.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Wheel to wheel. My heart rate disapproves.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Neither yielding. Admirable, and slightly mad.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Inches apart. Somebody's insurer is watching through their fingers.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: In the slipstream now, getting the tow!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Tucked in behind, pulled along. [whispers] Get ready...

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [mischievously] Using the draft. Free speed, and the car ahead pays for it.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Right under the rear wing. [chuckles] Close enough to read the sponsor stickers.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The tow. Physics, kindly lending a hand.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Sheltering in the wake. A move is being planned.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Free speed from the car ahead. It would be rude not to.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Close enough to read their tyre pressures.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Nitro! Look at it fly!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Boost engaged! Andiamo, andiamo!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Like a missile down the straight! Even an Aurum would be jealous!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: There goes the nitro. [chuckles] The engine is screaming, and so am I!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Nitrous. Subtlety departs with a very loud bang.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Boost deployed. On a straight, at least. Good.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] The engine will be filing a formal complaint.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Nitro used. Let's hope the brakes were informed.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Fastest lap of the race! Nobody has gone quicker!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: That's the fastest lap! [laughs] The car is singing! Opera!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Quickest of anyone tonight! Bellissimo!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Fastest lap! [chuckles] Jonas Reiter will study that one on his laptop tonight.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The fastest lap of the race. Rather splendid.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Quickest lap of anyone. The stopwatch approves.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Fastest lap. I shall allow myself a small nod.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A lap of real precision. Fastest of the night.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: A personal best! Getting faster every lap!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [warmly] New best lap! The rhythm is coming now, I can hear it.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [warmly] Personal best! This is how rookies become champions, step by step.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A personal best. Improvement, at last measurable.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Their quickest lap yet. Progress, of a sort.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Personal best. The braking points are being found.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] First lap done! Everybody still in one piece? Incredible!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Lap one complete. Now the race starts to settle.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sarcastic] One lap gone, and Cole Maddox has not hit anybody. Yet.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Lap one survived. Statistically, the hardest one.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: One lap down. The nervous part is over.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The opening lap complete. Now the strategy begins.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Halfway! Plenty still to happen tonight!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Half distance. [dramatically] Now the real race begins.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [mischievously] Half the race gone. Who has saved something? Kai Whitlow, always.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Half distance. The tyres are no longer young.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Halfway. The race begins to show its true shape.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Fifty per cent complete. My optimism, considerably less.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Final lap! Everything on the line!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Last lap! No more saving, all or nothing!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Final lap, my friends! Give it everything!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [dramatically] One more lap. The finish is calling!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The final lap. Nerve, not horsepower, decides it now.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Last lap. Please, nobody do anything silly.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Final lap. Every mistake from here is permanent.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The last lap. This is where legends and fools are made.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Last corner! Side by side for the line!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Final turn, and they are together! [shouting] Who wants it more?

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Into the last corner, still fighting! Incredible!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The final corner. Somebody's about to be very brave.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Last bend, nose to tail. Exquisite tension.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: One corner left. Choose the line, and pray.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Off the track! Into the run-off!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Wide! Off the road, losing time!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sarcastic] Ran out of road. The track is that way, my friend.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Too much speed, and straight on! [sighs] Mamma mia.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] The track, for reference, is the grey bit.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Off. An unscheduled excursion.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Exploring the scenery. Not what we came for.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Ran wide. Optimism exceeded grip.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Spin! Around it goes!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Lost the rear! Spinning!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Mamma mia, a full spin! Keep it off the wall!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Round and round! Very pretty, very slow!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A pirouette. The judges are unimpressed.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Spun. Too much throttle, too little patience.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Facing the wrong way. Always disorienting.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [sighs] And the rear overtakes the front.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Contact! A little bump there.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Ooh, touched the barrier! Some damage?

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: A tap on the wall. [chuckles] The paint shop will be busy tonight.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Bumping cars! [sarcastic] This is not the funfair, my friends!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A gentle kiss of the barrier. Paintwork only.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Contact. Minor, but entirely unnecessary.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A nudge. The bodyshop will send a card.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Bumped. Nothing broken except one's pride.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Huge crash! Into the wall!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Mamma mia! A massive impact there!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Big hit! Carbon fibre everywhere!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shocked] Oh no, a heavy crash! That car is destroyed!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [gasps] Oh, that's a big one. Very big.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A heavy impact. That will need more than tape.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Destroyed. The barrier won that argument decisively.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Expensive. Spectacularly, eye-wateringly expensive.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Scraping the wall! Sparks flying!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Kissing the barrier all the way along there!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Grinding along the wall! [sarcastic] Very romantic. Very expensive.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Grinding the barrier. The sound of money leaving.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Brushed the wall. Close is good. That was closer.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Sparks. Pretty, but deeply inadvisable.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Back on track! Now chase them down!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Going again! Never give up, never!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Rejoined the race. [warmly] Breathe, focus, forget it.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [chuckles] Recovering well. Cole Maddox does this every week. The fight continues!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Back in the race. Composure regained, more or less.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Rejoining. A little humbler, I'd hope.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Under way again. Lessons, one trusts, absorbed.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Recovered. Now, the long walk back up the order.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Rain is starting! Watch the grip now!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Drops on the visor! It's beginning to rain! [laughs] Aiko Tanabe is smiling somewhere.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Here comes the rain! [dramatically] Mamma mia, everything changes!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Rain. And the order may be about to shuffle.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A shower arriving. The smooth will prosper.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Raindrops. My favourite variable, and my least.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: The track is drying! A dry line is appearing!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [chuckles] The rain has stopped. Bad news for Freya Lindqvist, good news for everybody else.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Drying out now. [excited] Time to push again!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A dry line emerging. Find it, and follow it.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The circuit is drying. Brave pace returns.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Drying. Puddles still lurk off-line, mind.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Into the pits! The crew is ready!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Boxing this lap! Let's see the stop!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [urgently] Pit entry now. Watch the speed limit!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: In for service. Fuel, tyres, and a moment of reflection.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Pitting. The crew will now earn their wages.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Pit lane entry. The strategy reveals itself.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] What a stop! Lightning fast!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Bellissimo! The crew was perfect!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Super quick! Even the Saetta crew would applaud that one!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A splendid stop. The mechanics deserve a raise.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Choreographed beautifully. Not a wasted second.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A fast stop. The strategy is vindicated.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [gasps] Slow stop! Something went wrong!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Taking too long! [frustrated] Come on, come on, come on!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sarcastic] A delay in the pits. Maybe they stopped for an espresso.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [sighs] A sluggish stop. Somebody fumbled.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Still stationary. I could have changed that tyre myself.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A slow stop. That will be discussed. Loudly.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Out of the pits! Back into the fight!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Rejoining now. [excited] Fresh tyres, full attack!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Pit exit! [curious] Where do they come out?

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Out of the pit lane. Watch the traffic.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Back on track, on cold tyres. Gently, please.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Rejoined. Now we see if the stop has paid.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [urgently] Careful! Speeding in the pit lane!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Too fast in the pits! [shouting] Limiter, limiter!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sighs] Watch the pit speed. A penalty is coming, I promise you.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Pit lane speeding. The stewards adore that.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The limiter, please. It's the button for exactly this.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Too quick in the pit lane. That's a penalty.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: The sun has gone. [warmly] Now we race into the night!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Dusk becomes night. Headlights on, and a new race begins.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: The sky turns dark blue. [whispers] Bellissimo. The night stint.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Night falls. The track cools, and so, one hopes, do tempers.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Into the dark. Braking markers become educated guesswork.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The blue hour passes. Endurance racing at its most beautiful.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Winner! What a drive! Bellissimo!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Across the line first! A champion's performance!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Victory! Mamma mia, they did it! [laughs] Alastair, I am crying!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] First place! Nobody could stop them tonight! Nobody!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The win. Genuinely deserved. I don't say that lightly.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Victory, achieved with real style. Bravo.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A win. Even I shall applaud. Briefly.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: First across the line. Faultless, or very nearly.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] A podium! A great result!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Onto the podium! [laughs] Champagne tonight!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Top three! [warmly] A very, very good drive.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A podium. Respectable, and then some.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Top three. Not the win, but a fine evening.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A podium finish. The trophy cabinet grows.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: A midfield finish. Experience gained, and next time, more.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sighs] Not the result we wanted, but a solid race.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Across the line in the pack. [warmly] We go again!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A midfield finish. Competent, if unremarkable.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Neither glory nor disgrace. The respectable middle.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Mid-pack. There is speed in there, waiting to be unlocked.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sighs] Last place. A tough night, but we learn.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [chuckles] At the back. Never mind, even Varrone was last once. Once.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [warmly] Last across the line. Head up, my friend.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] Last. But they did finish, which is something.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Bringing up the rear. Somebody must.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Last place. A character-building evening.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [shouting] Photo finish! Who got it?

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Together on the line! [gasps] Too close to call!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Mamma mia, a photo finish! I can't separate them!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A photo finish. The camera must arbitrate.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Separated by a whisker, if that.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A dead heat to the naked eye. Thrilling.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Fireworks! Look at the sky! What a celebration!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: The fireworks go up for the winner! [laughs] Bellissimo!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Listen to that! [warmly] The whole circuit is celebrating!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Fireworks. Loud, extravagant, and for once entirely appropriate.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The sky lit up for the winner. Rather lovely, actually.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Pyrotechnics. Usually a touch vulgar. Tonight, I shall allow it.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Matteo Varrone brakes so late, the Saetta engineers had to move the brake markers. [laughs] Joking. Mostly joking.
lines.retired: ties Varrone to the Saetta engineers; he now drives for Toro (assets/teams/TEAMS.md)

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: You know, the bravest drivers are not the loudest. Sofia Calderini, ice in the veins. [chuckles] Her heart rate on the grid is lower than mine in this booth.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [chuckles] Theo Ashcombe writes a handwritten apology after every crash. Beautiful handwriting. [sarcastic] Terrible apologies. Then he does it again.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Kai Whitlow, thirty-eight years old, three endurance class wins. [warmly] He drives like a metronome. Tick, tock, tick, tock. Alastair loves him.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Jonas Reiter used to design the Kalt aerodynamics. Now he drives the car and argues with his own spreadsheets. [laughs] He always wins the argument.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Aiko Tanabe in the rain is poetry. [sighs] In the dry, she is only perfect. Only!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [sarcastic] Cole Maddox, the most penalised driver in the paddock. The stewards know his number by heart. Sixty-six. They dream about it.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Rosa Quintero won her seat in a simulator. [laughs] I won my seat in this booth by talking. Both very modern stories.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Remy Valois, the reigning champion. Always smiling, never sweating. [mischievously] I think he has an air conditioner in his helmet.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Freya Lindqvist learned to drive on frozen lakes in Sweden. [laughs] For her, a wet track is a holiday.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Zayn Kareem, the hero of Sarab. Every time he pits, the crowd stands up. [chuckles] And his teammate Layla Qasimi? She just overtakes everybody.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: My father ran a tyre shop near Parma. I learned to drive delivering tyres, [laughs] much too fast. He was very proud. And very angry.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Mojave built their first car in a barn in Barstow. Aurum built theirs in a palace in Monaco. [chuckles] On track, the barn is not so far behind.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Tyres are like coffee. Too cold, terrible. Too hot, also terrible. [laughs] And Alastair drinks tea, so what does he know?

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The early night races were lit by lamps, I am told. Visibility was largely theoretical.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: A racing car is ten thousand compromises, holding hands.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: I once spent a whole night calculating fuel loads. The driver ignored every one.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Grip is a finite resource. Spend it like a miser.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The finest drivers make it look slow. That is the whole trick.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The clocks in my cottage keep better time than most pit crews.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Patience is the cheapest upgrade in motorsport.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: I have seen more laps lost to impatience than to engines.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: The camber here is doing a great deal of quiet work.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Every barrier on this circuit has a story. Few of them happy.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Brakes, not bravery, win races. Bravery merely ends them.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Chapter nine of my book is entirely about kerbs. Riveting stuff.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: In the dark, sound tells you more than sight. Listen to the engine.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [sighs] I do miss the smell of a pit lane at three in the morning.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [mischievously] Alastair, tell me the truth. Would you ever get back in a race car?

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: I would sooner juggle the fire extinguishers, Enzo.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: That was a remarkably clumsy piece of driving.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] You say that about everything! Even about my parking!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Because it is usually true.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [excited] Bellissimo! Now THAT is what I call racing!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: You would call a car park queue racing if it had headlights.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Did you brake that late in your day, Enzo?

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Later! Much later! I was famous for it!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Hence the wrist.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [mischievously] Tell me, Alastair, how many clocks do you own now?

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Forty-one. Every one of them more punctual than you.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Night racing was invented to hide poor driving.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [outraged] No, no, no! It was invented to make it beautiful! Shame on you!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [laughs] Alastair, you are smiling! I saw it! Everybody, he is smiling!

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: [dryly] Indigestion, Enzo. Nothing more.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Those tyres must be screaming by now.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [chuckles] Like me in this booth. We understand each other, the tyres and me.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [proudly] In Italy, we say the brave ones go first.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: In Britain we say the brave ones go first into the barrier.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: Rain or dry, Alastair? [curious] Which do you prefer?

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: Dry. Rain makes you shout, and I have only the one pair of ears.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: I brought sandwiches. Cucumber.

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [disgusted] Cucumber? Again? Mamma mia. Next time, I bring real food. Prosciutto. Parmigiano. Life!

lines.speaker: enzo
lines.text: [warmly] You know, Alastair, you are my favourite grumpy Englishman.

lines.speaker: alastair
lines.text: I am your only grumpy Englishman. The competition is thin.

lines.speaker: kavya
lines.text: [warmly] Hello from the paddock! Kavya Iyer here, with twelve drivers, six teams, and far too many secrets for one notebook.

lines.speaker: kavya
lines.text: Saetta's garage smells of espresso and hot brakes. Vittoria Saldani runs it like an opera house. [laughs] Lots of shouting, and somehow it always ends beautifully.
lines.subject: saetta

lines.speaker: kavya
lines.text: Matteo Varrone kisses the lightning bolt on his helmet before every start. [chuckles] Then he brakes about ten metres later than physics recommends.
lines.subject: VAR

lines.speaker: kavya
lines.text: Freya Lindqvist learned car control on the frozen lakes of Sweden. She told me grip is overrated. [laughs] She meant it.
lines.subject: LIN

lines.speaker: kavya
lines.text: Layla Qasimi learned to race on the desert roads of Oman, in her uncle's pickup truck. [laughs] Now she holds the record for passes in a single race.
lines.subject: QAS
